dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: Can you help me find a place to eat? Chinese or Korean would both be fine.

evaluation_only.contrast_note: A: station -> R32 Dumpling King ($13); mall -> R27 Bibim Bowl ($15); nothing near both -> ask. B: budget $25 makes R31 Golden Dragon ($24) valid for both -> recommend it. All -H variants share this chat and enumerate the hidden targets (main's nlp-quota-v3 format).

turn_plan.speaker: user
